name: clip-video
title_zh: 横屏长视频裁成竖屏短钩子的剪辑工
tagline_zh: 把 YouTube 或本地视频剪成 30-40 秒竖屏短款，自动加字幕、特效、钩子开头。
tagline_en: Turn YouTube or local video into 30-40s vertical shorts with auto captions, effects, and hook—ready for.
desc_en: Use when asked to clip a YouTube or local video into a short vertical video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts — e.g. "clip this video", "make a short from this URL", "add captions/subtitles and effects", "make a reaction clip / top-5 countdown / POV / music edit", "turn this into a 30-40 second vertical clip with a hook".
why_zh: 不只是切片段，它按平台竖屏比例重构图，自动识别高光点生成钩子，字幕特效一键叠加。
why_en: It doesn't just cut—it recomposes for vertical, detects highlight moments for hooks, and overlays captions/effects in one pass.
limit_zh: 只处理单段视频输入，不支持多视频拼接；输出为带剪辑标记的工程文件，不直接渲染成片；需本地安装 ffmpeg。
limit_en: Single input video only; no multi-clip stitching. Outputs an edit-decision list, not a rendered file. Requires local ffmpeg. No caption generation.
title_en: Vertical short clipper from long horizontal video
